jobs.title: GIS Specialist
jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

The GIS Specialist will support infrastructure and roads engineering projects by leveraging Geographic Information Systems technology for design, mapping, and spatial analysis. This role combines technical GIS expertise with infrastructure and transportation systems knowledge to support project planning, asset management, and system optimization.

Key Responsibilities:

Works under general supervision on infrastructure and roads systems GIS projects.
Programs and designs Geographic Information Systems for roads infrastructure mapping, network analysis, and spatial planning.
Under supervision, contributes to the design and development of geodatabases for road networks, transportation corridors, and infrastructure assets.
Compiles, validates, and analyzes GIS data related to roads infrastructure, traffic systems, and engineering networks.
Creates spatial databases and manages geospatial information for infrastructure planning and design applications.
Generates technical maps, reports, and spatial analyses to support infrastructure engineering decisions and transportation system optimization.
Converts, transfers, and integrates GIS data from multiple sources using industry-standard GIS software and engineering applications.
May supervise technicians in data assembly, quality assurance, and GIS input/output processes for infrastructure projects.
Receives instruction on specific infrastructure assignments, engineering objectives, and complex spatial analysis requirements.
Applies sound professional judgment in resolving technical GIS challenges related to roads and infrastructure engineering projects.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geography, Civil Engineering, Geomatics, or related field
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in GIS design, development, and spatial analysis
Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing Geographic Information Systems for infrastructure and transportation projects
Proficiency with industry-standard GIS software (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS, or equivalent platforms)
Strong experience in geodatabase design, development, and management for large-scale infrastructure networks
Proven ability to compile, validate, and analyze geospatial data related to infrastructure systems and transportation networks
Experience creating technical maps, reports, and spatial analyses for engineering and infrastructure planning applications
Proficiency in GIS data conversion, integration, and transfer from multiple sources
Strong technical problem-solving skills and sound professional judgment in resolving complex GIS challenges
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document technical processes and findings

Preferred Qualifications:

Professional experience in the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region
Experience with infrastructure and roads engineering projects in the GCC
GIS certification (e.g., Esri Technical Certification, GIS Professional Certification)
Experience supervising GIS technicians and managing data quality assurance processes
Knowledge of transportation systems analysis and network optimization
Experience with engineering applications and CAD integration with GIS platforms
Familiarity with infrastructure asset management systems

Additional Information

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
What is FCG?

FCG, a product-based technology consulting company serving top North American clients and providing the most innovative technology solutions from the past 10 years in the domain of Utility, gas pipeline, roadways and permitting systems. We are made up of more than 50+ software professionals and researchers (and growing) who live and breathe technology. With our core principles and values, we always believed in challenging ourselves to bring out the best products and to constantly improve and invest in latest technologies such as Cloud Computing, Dev-Ops, GIS, Big Data and Analytics.

We are an STPI unit operating from IT park Bhopal with high end infrastructure and due to COVID-19 we are providing the work from home.

Why work at FCG?

FCG is on a mission to create a place where you can learn and grow, where your ideas are valued and where you can do cool things, all while contributing to the larger success of the company. At FCG we incorporate and promote a culture of creativity, innovation, and collaboration to allow everyone to do their best work every day. Our core management team aims to provide you very friendly environment with guidance at every step.

Education

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science/ Information Technology/ GIS/ Geoinformatics with overall high academics.

Experience

6- 7 years of experience as a GIS Developer (Senior)

Job Requirements

6 to 7 years experience in developing websites, custom web mapping applications using
Net, ESRI Arc GIS, Arc Objects, Arc GIS Server side programming, ArcGIS Java script API
Proven experience with Microsoft .NET technologies including, ASP.NET, ADO.NET Languages: C#, VB.Net, SQL/T-SQL, JavaScript/DHTML, VBScript, HTML, XML, Open source as well as Google Map API
Experience in web mapping application development using AGOL (ArcGIS Online) – Web app builder and custom web app templates & custom widgets, ArcGIS Silverlight API, JavaScript API, ArcGIS Python script
Experience in SQL Server 2005/2008/2012, ORACLE 11g,12C including schema design and writing complex SQL, stored procedures, and views etc.
Experience in working with ArcSDE geo database platform
Experience in developing websites using Telerik’s R.A.D. Editor would be preferred
Some experience with front end UI (User Interface) design
Write Oracle geospatial SQL procedures to find intersections between layers and
generate new geospatial data points marking the intersections using only SQL.
Complete understanding of Oracle SDO_GEOMETRY and related data types.
Knowledge of ESRI ArcGIS Server published map services, ESRI ArcGIS Desktop, Queries, Joins, Map file configuration

Role & Responsibilities

Working with Project Manager to define needs and applying / customizing existing technology to meet those needs
Working on GIS (Geographic Information System) product Development
The candidate should be flexible, highly adaptable, and excellent team player.
The candidate should expect to work in a global virtual team spread across North America and India team members, sometimes across multiple time zones.
The candidate may be assigned to more than one role or project at a time.
Our ideal candidate will be a self-motivated team player committed to delivering on time and should be able to work with minimal supervision.
Perform R&D related to Development work
Good Communication: English Verbal & Written Communication is a must

If you are interested in this exciting, challenging position with FCG, apply today by sending out your Resume to jobs@flairsoftgroup.com.

jobs.title: Drone System Reliability Technician and Pilot
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About The Role

As a Drone System Validation Technician and Pilot
, you will be at the front line of our quality, safety, and reliability efforts. Your primary mission is to ensure that our defense-grade products meet rigorous operational standards before they are cleared for active duty.

Working within a dedicated flight testing team, you will manage, prepare, and operate fleets of newly assembled drones or related product during intensive field validation campaigns. By logging massive operating hours, you will actively hunt for rare, hard-to-replicate system bugs and edge-case anomalies. We are looking for operators who combine rigorous testing discipline with the hands-on piloting expertise required to accurately assess and validate nominal drone behavior in flight. Your technical feedback will directly enable our engineering teams to secure and polish our next-generation defense systems.

Responsibilities

Intensive Flight Testing: Conduct high-volume flight testing of newly assembled interceptors to log hours, validate systems, and actively hunt for rare, intermittent flight anomalies.
Aviation Performance Assessment: Manually operate, stress-test, and critically evaluate the flight dynamics of various platforms (multirotors, fixed-wing, flying wings, and RC planes) to ensure they handle exactly as designed.
Field Deployment: Lead and execute demanding on-site flight missions, sometimes lasting several weeks, under diverse weather and environmental conditions.
Mission Safety & Logs: Rigorously follow test checklists, maintain safety protocols during high-throughput flight operations, and accurately report flight observations to the engineering, production and industrialisation teams.

Candidate Requirements

Good RC/UAV Piloting Skills: You have extensive hands-on experience piloting RC planes, flying wings, or multirotor UAVs. Manual piloting dexterity and a deep instinct for flight mechanics are the absolute priorities for this role.
Rigor & Endurance: Strong discipline to run repetitive, structured test cycles with consistent attention to detail and unwavering focus on safety.
Adaptable Mindset: You thrive in fast-paced, lean startup environments where initiative, quick decision-making, and teamwork are valued over rigid hierarchy.
Field-Ready & Mobile: You possess a valid driver’s license (Permis B) and are ready to drive team vehicles, transport flight gear/drones. You are looking for a highly active, hands-on role where you will be out in the field on a daily basis, all year round.
Technical background: Any technical degree or professional experience in electronics, RC modeling, mechanics, or aeronautics is a great plus, but passionate self-taught pilots are highly encouraged to apply.
Basic Technical English: Capable of understanding technical guidelines and writing flight reports in English.

Nice-to-have

Certifications & FPV: Official drone pilot certifications, instructor ratings, or solid FPV (First Person View) racing/freestyle experience.
Military or Field Background: Past experience in specialized military units or demanding field-oriented professions.
Basic data/technical literacy: a basic grasp of autopilot systems, telemetry or flight-log reading, to help bridge the field and R&D. This is what turns an operator into a genuine validator, and is worth probing even if not required.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Drone System Validation Technician and Pilot
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About The Role

As a Drone System Validation Technician and Pilot
, you are working hand in hand with the validation engineer, you prepare and operate our systems in real conditions, fly them during test campaigns, and turn what you see in the field into clear feedback for engineering.

What you'll do

Test support: Work alongside the validation engineer to prepare, set up and run test campaigns; build and prepare the tooling, fixtures and test setups needed to get a campaign off the ground.
Flight operations: Pilot our drones during tests and act as safety operator, from routine flights to more demanding campaigns.
Field deployment: Set up the test site from scratch, load and prepare the test vehicle/truck, deploy and connect the systems under test and run the campaign safely.
Test execution & reporting: Run test protocols and checklists rigorously, and report results, anomalies and their frequency clearly so engineering can act on them.
Hands-on preparation & upkeep: Prepare, assemble, repair and upgrade the equipment you fly and test (soldering, wiring, mechanical assembly, part replacement) to keep campaigns moving.

What we're looking for

Technical degree or equivalent hands-on experience in electronics, mechanics, or RC modeling.
Confirmed drone pilot.
Strong manual and technical skills: soldering, wiring, mechanical assembly, and comfort troubleshooting hardware in the field; CAD and 3D printing skills are a strong plus, as much of the tooling and fixtures are designed and produced in-house.
Organized, rigorous, and safety-conscious, with a genuine hands-on/DIY mindset and eagerness to learn our systems, able to keep consistency across repetitive test cycles.
Comfortable working outdoors and physically active work, including loading a vehicle and spending full days in the field in all weather.
Basic Linux familiarity is a plus (operating our systems, fetching and handling logs); a basic understanding of flight-computer/autopilot systems is a bonus.
Willingness to travel and a valid driving licence: frequent local field campaigns.
English at a working level (A2 minimum). French or Arabic is a plus.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

This role requires flexibility, physical stamina, and the ability to work both independently and across multiple sites.

As our Ground Operations Lead, you aren't just managing a floor; you're the captain of a high-tech launch site. You'll be the bridge between ground operations and flight, ensuring every package is prepped with precision and every drone is ready for departure.

work hours: Rotating Shifts

, you will be at the front line of our quality, safety, and reliability efforts. Your primary mission is to ensure that our defense-grade products meet rigorous operational standards before they are cleared for active duty.

Working within a dedicated flight testing team, you will manage, prepare, and operate fleets of newly assembled drones or related product during intensive field validation campaigns. By logging massive operating hours, you will actively hunt for rare, hard-to-replicate system bugs and edge-case anomalies. We are looking for operators who combine rigorous testing discipline with the hands-on piloting expertise required to accurately assess and validate nominal drone behavior in flight. Your technical feedback will directly enable our engineering teams to secure and polish our next-generation defense systems.

Responsibilities

Intensive Flight Testing: Conduct high-volume flight testing of newly assembled interceptors to log hours, validate systems, and actively hunt for rare, intermittent flight anomalies.
Aviation Performance Assessment: Manually operate, stress-test, and critically evaluate the flight dynamics of various platforms (multirotors, fixed-wing, flying wings, and RC planes) to ensure they handle exactly as designed.
Field Deployment: Lead and execute demanding on-site flight missions, sometimes lasting several weeks, under diverse weather and environmental conditions.
Mission Safety & Logs: Rigorously follow test checklists, maintain safety protocols during high-throughput flight operations, and accurately report flight observations to the engineering, production and industrialisation teams.

Candidate Requirements

Good RC/UAV Piloting Skills: You have extensive hands-on experience piloting RC planes, flying wings, or multirotor UAVs. Manual piloting dexterity and a deep instinct for flight mechanics are the absolute priorities for this role.
Rigor & Endurance: Strong discipline to run repetitive, structured test cycles with consistent attention to detail and unwavering focus on safety.
Adaptable Mindset: You thrive in fast-paced, lean startup environments where initiative, quick decision-making, and teamwork are valued over rigid hierarchy.
Field-Ready & Mobile: You possess a valid driver’s license (Permis B) and are ready to drive team vehicles, transport flight gear/drones. You are looking for a highly active, hands-on role where you will be out in the field on a daily basis, all year round.
Technical background: Any technical degree or professional experience in electronics, RC modeling, mechanics, or aeronautics is a great plus, but passionate self-taught pilots are highly encouraged to apply.
Basic Technical English: Capable of understanding technical guidelines and writing flight reports in English.

Nice-to-have

Certifications & FPV: Official drone pilot certifications, instructor ratings, or solid FPV (First Person View) racing/freestyle experience.
Military or Field Background: Past experience in specialized military units or demanding field-oriented professions.
Basic data/technical literacy: a basic grasp of autopilot systems, telemetry or flight-log reading, to help bridge the field and R&D. This is what turns an operator into a genuine validator, and is worth probing even if not required.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

, you are working hand in hand with the validation engineer, you prepare and operate our systems in real conditions, fly them during test campaigns, and turn what you see in the field into clear feedback for engineering.

Field deployment: Set up the test site from scratch, load and prepare the test vehicle/truck, deploy and connect the systems under test and run the campaign safely.
